records.text: Kiriakou said that because a kid from Utah allegedly shot Charlie Kirk in Utah and no one crossed state lines, nothing would make the case federal unless there were a conspiracy.
records.speaker: John Kiriakou

appearances.snippet: Why is the FBI involved in this? Charlie Kirk was killed in Utah by a kid from Utah who left his house in Utah, drove to the university in Utah. and allegedly shot Charlie Kirk. Nobody ever crossed a state line. There's literally nothing in this case that would make it federal unless there was a conspiracy, in which case it would be a federal case and the FBI would be involved.

verification.notes: The original Danny Jones recording directly confirms that Kiriakou made the quoted remarks: he described the suspect and events as confined to Utah, said no one crossed a state line, and said only a conspiracy would make it federal. This verifies the attribution and wording. It does not adopt Kiriakou's legal analysis as independently correct.
